name: Voalack
status: Original editable vector identity; project adoption pending.
meaning: A deliberate acknowledgement is handed toward a precise receiver. The visible separation keeps the request and its destination distinct.

construction.receiver: Rounded receiver open left; one filled path.
construction.handoff: Separate 184 by 72 unit capsule, vertically centred; one filled path.
construction.wordmark: Seven purpose-drawn lowercase letter paths and a circular period.

clear_space.rule: Keep one inner-gap width (64 mark units) clear around the complete mark or lockup.
clear_space.icon_exception: Supplied favicon and app icon already include internal padding.

minimum_sizes.guidance: Use the padded favicon below 24 px. Do not close the gap or add small details.

assets.voalack-mark.svg: Cobalt receiver and ink capsule; light surfaces.
assets.voalack-mark-dark.svg: Periwinkle receiver and off-white capsule; dark surfaces.
assets.voalack-mark-mono.svg: Ink mark for light surfaces and one-colour output.
assets.voalack-mark-white.svg: White mark for dark surfaces and reversed output.
assets.voalack-logo-light.svg: Cobalt receiver and period, ink capsule and letters; light surfaces.
assets.voalack-logo-dark.svg: Periwinkle receiver and period, off-white capsule and letters; dark surfaces.
assets.voalack-logo-white.svg: All-white horizontal lockup; reversed one-colour output.
assets.favicon.svg: White mark on a padded cobalt rounded square; 16–32 px.
assets.voalack-app-icon.svg: 512-unit master of the same icon composition.

usage: Keep the receiver open on the left and the capsule separate.
Preserve the two paths, their weight and the negative-space gap.
Keep the period matched to the receiver colour: cobalt on light surfaces, periwinkle on dark surfaces.
Use the appropriate light, dark, ink or white variant.
Do not stretch, rotate, outline, merge the shapes or add shadows and gradients to the logo.
The mark does not represent bidirectional synchronisation, backup, recovery or guaranteed delivery.
rights_note: Original geometry and lettering. No vendor logos, branded font files or third-party artwork are embedded. No trademark clearance, registration, certification or affiliation is asserted. Licensing is left to the repository owner.
